finding: Win32_LogicalDisk CIM fields were directly cast to double outside Safe-Collect and weren't checked for NaN/Infinity. A malformed volume could abort the report or misrepresent missing data as complete inventory.
changes: Moved the existing packaged telemetry_analysis.ps1 dot-source before logical-disk processing, without adding extra modules.
Added pure ConvertTo-PcCareVolumeSample to validate C: letter, finite numeric capacity/free bytes, bounds, decimal rounding and no raw volume label or path.
diagnose.ps1 skips malformed volumes, preserves good volumes, emits generic limitation, records volumeRejectedCount, marks collectionStatus.volumes=incomplete when any result was rejected.
Added synthetic PowerShell 5.1 fixtures and Python source contracts; H08 already requires volumes status collected to compare.

previous_release_zip_python_tests_rerun.scope: Same unchanged original release.py + test_release.py in local container; not newly modified diagnostic code

safety: Only feature/pc-care-usb code, synthetic tests, QA evidence and handoff. No actual Windows event reads, repairs, customer reports, production/main or cloud configuration changes.
